children: Tilly's posted second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with net sales of $163.5 million and net income of $8.4 million, marking improved profitability versus the prior-year quarter. Comparable net sales rose 12.1% for the quarter and 16.5% year-to-date, driven by stronger e-commerce and improved in-store performance. Management said the company is profitable on a trailing four-quarter and year-to-date basis and expects to be profitable for fiscal 2026 if momentum continues.
Revenue: Total net sales of $163.5 million for the thirteen weeks ended August 1, 2026, up 8.1% year-over-year.
Gross profit: $58.1 million, representing 35.5% of net sales (improvement of 300 basis points versus prior-year quarter).
Operating income: $8.2 million, or 5.0% of net sales, versus $2.7 million (1.8% of net sales) in the prior-year quarter.
Net income: $8.4 million, or $0.27 per diluted share, compared with $3.2 million, or $0.10 per diluted share, in the prior-year quarter.

Liquidity: Total available liquidity of $125.5 million as of August 1, 2026, including $62.2 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and $63.3 million in undrawn borrowing capacity.
Comparable sales momentum: Total comparable net sales increased 12.1% in the quarter (13th consecutive month of comparable growth when including August) and 16.5% for the first half year-over-year.
Channel mix: E-commerce net sales grew 20.9% in the quarter and represented 21.1% of total net sales, up from 18.9% a year earlier; physical stores comparable sales increased 10.3% for the quarter.
Store footprint: The company operated 220 stores at quarter end, a net decrease of 12 stores versus the year-ago quarter; expected to have 220 stores at the end of Q3 fiscal 2026.
Inventory and margin trends: Improved product margins for the seventh consecutive quarter and healthier inventory aging contributing to better full-price selling and reduced markdowns.

Outlook for Q3 FY2026: Management estimates net sales of $150M–$155M (comparable increase of 10%–14%), SG&A of ~$47M–$49M, an effective tax rate in the low- to mid-teens, and net income of ~$2.2M–$3.7M ($0.07–$0.12 per diluted share, ~32.0M diluted shares).
